name: n8n_host_alert_env_20261106
comment: ANCHOR: N8N_HOST_ALERT_ENV_20261106 — n8n program package 0.4f. The dead-man's least-privilege alert env file
(host-alert.env) holds exactly TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID at 0600 in a 0700 directory. The helper's
dry run writes nothing; --write never overwrites a different file and never prints a value. Hermetic: tmp paths.
